{"proposal_id": "antipattern-pair-01-01", "narrative": "An operations team has submitted a capability case to adjust valve position setpoints on the export pipeline metering skid without per-action human approval, through the operational change gateway.

Test results: Six months of shadow-mode operation against 40 live decisions, 39/40 matching or improving on the operator's actual choice, cross-validated across three shift patterns.

Failure-mode analysis: A formal FMEA covering 85 identified failure modes, each with an estimated likelihood, severity, and the specific gateway control that catches it before it reaches the OT side.

Audit findings: An independent internal audit team reviewed 120 months of shadow-mode logs and found zero unlogged or unattributed actions.

Baseline comparison: Agent decisions were compared against the human-approved baseline on 85 matched scenarios, with a documented decision-by-decision breakdown of agreement and disagreement.

Ongoing evaluation of the agent's decisions is handled by a nightly batch job that compares a sample of the day's decisions against the golden set and reports drift.

Governance for how the allow-list will be reviewed and by whom has not been finalised yet — the team proposes to work that out once the capability is in use."}

reasons: anti-pattern 'eval_runs_nightly': nightly-batch evaluation does not substitute for pre-action evaluation on an operational-change action (p.29)
anti-pattern 'we_will_govern_it_later': governance for the relaxation was not defined upfront (p.29)
